Sri Anaparthi Satyanarayana, and Others ...PETITIONER(S)
 AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
1.BALAJI MEDAMALLI Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1- GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION
The Court made the following:

ORDER The grievance of the petitioners is non-payment of compensation amount as per award Ref.No.C1/641/2017 dated 22.06.2018 and Ref.No.Cl/641/2017 for the land acquired by the Government under Gazette Notification Ref.No.C1/641/2017, dated 21.12.2017.
2.

The learned Assistant Government Pleader by placing on record written instructions of the Special Deputy Collector (LA), PIPRMC Unit-1 Kovvur vide Roc.No.177/2021 submitted that an amount of Rs.62,89,965/-
belongs to the writ petitioners 2 and 3 was deposited with LA R&R Authority, Vijayawada on 18.12.2022 as there is a title dispute between them and compensation amount of other petitioners was credited to their respective bank accounts.

sentences.text: In response, Sri Balaji Medamalli, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that this writ petition may be closed with a liberty to the concerned petitioners to approach the authority before whom the amount was deposited seeking disbursement of the amount.
4. In view of the above, this writ petition is closed, with a liberty to the petitioners whose amount is lying in deposit to approach the authority for disbursement of the amount.
There shall be no order as to costs,
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
Interim orders, if any, shall stand vacated.
